description: Source code for the LogPage class in Apache Spark's worker UI module, responsible for rendering and fetching log files via HTTP requests.

classes.name: LogPage
classes.description: A web UI page class for displaying logs in Spark's worker UI, supporting log retrieval and display.

methods.name: renderLog
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to fetch and display a segment of a log file based on parameters.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the log page, including controls and log data.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves a specific byte range from log files, supporting log type filtering and directory validation.
